VI.description: Open a VI THROUGH a project and show its front panel\2C so it is loaded in that project's application instance - what NI's OpenFile RPC does with a VI and a project pair.\0A\0AWHY IT EXISTS. On the pylabview backend lvai_open_file opened only a project and refused a VI\2C so a caller that needed a VI loaded - lvai_close_vi needs it opened THROUGH its project\2C or the State write later fails - had to switch to NI's service. Run over ActiveX this VI executes in LabVIEW's main application instance\2C which is the IDE's\3B Project.Open hands back the project LabVIEW already holds\2C or opens it\2C and the VI is opened in the project's own instance through Application\2C the bridge lvai_close_vi uses.\0A\0AThe panel is opened without activating it\2C so the IDE keeps its foreground window.
